design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "My Cat IS the Halloween Decoration" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a black cat sitting inside a carved jack-o-lantern. The cat's face is centered within the pumpkin's hollow interior, ears perked up, with a calm confident expression. The pumpkin has a classic triangular eye, nose, and toothy grin carved into it, glowing with warmth. Solid color blocks, no gradients, no airbrush shading, no photorealism. Limited palette: black cat, orange pumpkin, deep purple background, cream carved details, dark green stem. Single centered composition on a plain deep purple background with generous margins. Screen-print aesthetic, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, high contrast. Design readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
